name: 90670 · Santa Fe Spgs, CA
findings: ZIP 90670 (Santa Fe Spgs) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90670 (Santa Fe Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
